sources.entry: LandscapioAI - AI landscape design generator that turns yard photos into outdoor redesign concepts and cost estimates. #freemium

summary.name: LandscapioAI
summary.one_liner: A free AI landscape design generator that turns a photo of your yard into redesign concepts with cost estimates and contractor-ready plans.
use_cases: Previewing redesign ideas for a yard before hiring a designer
Estimating landscaping project costs before getting quotes
Creating a brief to hand to a landscape contractor
Planning a patio, planting, or privacy layout in phases
Staging outdoor spaces for real estate listings
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes an uploaded yard photo (JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP up to 10MB) and generates a redesign concept, shown as a before-and-after visualization. The page says the generated plan includes a line-by-line budget with upper and lower ranges (stated as ±15% accuracy), project areas with estimated sizes and material requirements, regional plant recommendations, and a design-build brief for contractors. Users can also describe a style and get phase-by-phase and maintenance suggestions as optional extras. The site includes cost guides for fences, driveways, concrete patios, retaining walls and outdoor kitchens, plus about 31 free landscaping calculators.
notable: Line-by-line cost estimate with stated ±15% range
Free landscaping cost guides and about 31 calculators
Contractor-ready design-build brief and material lists
caveats: Page says 'free to start' and 'free forever' but does not spell out what paid tiers include, so the limits of the free plan are unclear
Cost figures are estimates with a stated ±15% accuracy, not firm quotes
Page mixes marketing claims (such as '92% of users' and a 4.9/5 rating from early users) with little independent verification
